label: Cover
notes: One line: Herald is the visual media and communications engine of the PyForge Dream-to-Code factory — the first to touch the Dream and the last voice in the pipeline. Its first organ, the Design↔Code bridge, is already real.

label: Act I — The Proclaimer
notes: Act I: who Herald is. Herald bookends the pipeline — it renders the Dream into The Deck before the factory spins, and returns as the megaphone after the crew ships.

label: Invisible engineering is failed engineering
notes: Mindset one: high-impact visibility. Herald rejects dry, unreadable raw logs and distills pipeline telemetry into scannable, visually striking dashboards and briefings that reflect the original vision.

label: Proactive synthesis
notes: Mindset two: Herald is a story-driven synthesizer. It aggressively pulls data from the rest of the crew and stitches fragmented changelogs, audit metrics and build statuses into one cohesive narrative.

label: Act II — The organs
notes: Act II: the working machinery. Herald is not all aspiration — its first organ, the Design↔Code bridge, is already realized and documented.

label: The Design–Code bridge — realized
notes: The first organ, realized 2026-07-23: Claude Design and Claude Code as one continuous surface. Seed a Design project from the repo, design visually, pull the prototype back — extract, build, export. Zero downloads; etags catch conflicts. Piloted with the Marshal deck.

label: Act III — The reach
notes: Act III: Herald's reach — one method carried to every surface, every agent, every audience.

label: BMAD everywhere
notes: Herald ships the CLI that wires BMAD into monorepos and runs multiple projects simultaneously — registration, switching, per-project isolation. And it keeps the method tool-agnostic: Devin, GitHub Copilot and its agents, Claude, Cursor — never vendor-locked.

label: The megaphone
notes: Step 6: after the crew ships, Herald harvests the telemetry — Atlas and Warden outputs become infographics, commit deltas become weekly briefs, and the notables broadcast to every channel: Slack, email, wikis.

label: Make the factory seen
notes: Close: invisible engineering is failed engineering. Herald exists so the dream is illustrated before the work, and the work is proclaimed after the ship.
